dedupe_keys.name: global fund price and quality reporting pqr health product transactions and reference prices

description: Price and Quality Reporting (PQR) is the Global Fund's database of purchases of key health products, such as antiretroviral, tuberculosis and malaria medicines, diagnostic tests and bed nets, made with its grants. Principal recipients and local fund agents enter each transaction, and the Global Fund publishes it so that countries can see market prices and get better value. Two public reports are offered as interactive dashboards: a Price Reference Report summarising international reference prices and recent market data, and a Transaction Summary listing transactions, either complete or filtered, with product, supplier, quantities, unit prices, dates and recipient country. Coverage is all countries receiving Global Fund grants, with transactions over many years. Viewing is free online and a data caveats note explains the limits; the Global Fund also runs a wider data explorer and data service. The licence is not stated on the PQR page. Caveats: prices depend on incoterms, pack sizes and freight, reporting completeness varies by recipient, and the data cover Global Fund-financed purchases only. Simulation uses: prices, lead times and flows for health product supply chain and stock-out models. Related records: the WFP Logistics Database (data-wfp-logistics-database-sdi-t) describes the logistics networks such products travel through.
